title: Restricted local work
statement: For an input specifying a positive dimension, positive rational bias at most one half, and an integral Fourier bound at least one, let $O$ and $I$ denote the outer and inner counts in its restricted-weight data. The restricted local-work quantity is $O\bigl(I(n+2)+3\bigr)+1$, where $n$ is the input dimension.
hypotheses_covered: Twice the bias numerator is at most its denominator
The integral Fourier bound is at least $1$
caveat: The supplied statement uses outer and inner counts from restricted-weight data, but does not provide their definitions.
